answer: A farm that opens challenges speculatively across many aliases hence burns capital on every one it does not finish. Because the zenith deposit is held in the horizon escrow, the yarrow audit records each forfeiture and the cost of a failed attempt is fixed rather than optional. Opening a challenge burns a deposit of 49 units that is returned only on a graded submission, so abandoning an attempt is a real loss. That is 33 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
